To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the semiotics of digital utterance is a new and promising field of study; (ii) the study of digital utterance should be conducted in a way similar to the study of any other utterance; (iii) digital utterance is characterized by its digital and interactive properties; (iv) the semiotics approach to digital utterance can be extended to the study of digital interaction; and (v) the study of interaction is important for the study of digital media.
(1) The use of social media by the public is a relatively new phenomenon.
The semiotic analysis of media is an interdisciplinary research that combines semiotics with media studies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of the semiotic process of the production of meaning and its interpretation.
how the semiotic process is structured in the digital world.
the way in which the media, as an interpretative system, is able to produce meaning, and how it is able to be perceived.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Interpretation of the Semiosis is not a mental process but the result of a process of production of meaning.
semiotics is the study of the production of meaning, and the interpretation of signs and symbols.
“semiosis is the production of meaning in a context”.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the semiotic process is a process of production, which is a production of meaning and not a process of understanding.
the semiotics is a science that is based on the analysis of signs and their interpretation.
we should not forget that the interpretative process is governed by a strategy and that it is the reality that the sign builds up.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can consider the media as an extension of human mind, which means that the semiosis of the media is the result of the interaction between the human mind and the media.
semiosis is a dynamic process, a process of interaction between two subjects, the subject of the expression and the subject of the interpretation.
the interpretive process is not the same for all semiotic systems.
